Let God arise -- The entire Psalm is pervaded by the joy of Israel in the kingdom, but a stricter order of events begins with verse 18. This is quoted Ephesians 4:7-16 of Christ's ascension ministry. Verses 21-23 refer to the regathering of Israel, and the destruction of the Beast and his armies.

(See "Beast," (See Scofield "Daniel 7:8"))

Verses 24-35 are descriptive of full and universal kingdom blessing.
